title: Seminar: fair play and ethical values in sport
excerpt: Fair play and ethical values in sport
body_html:
The Moldovan Football Federation (FMF) and the Ukrainian Association of Football (UAF) held a seminar on fair play and promoting ethical values in sport. Special guests at the event were ATTP President Rostislav Sobiețki, who is also a member of the FMF ethics committee; ATTP Operations Director Alina Lucico, responsible for organising sporting events under the auspices of ATTP; and ATTP founder and TOP CUP Academy President Oleg Dobrjinschi.

The speakers were guests from the neighbouring country: Andrei Dovidenco, chair of the integrity committee of the Ukrainian Association of Football, and Andrei Nekrutov, a member of the same committee and head of the integrity department at BETER (an ATTP partner), who presented the latest strategies and tools for fighting corruption in sport.

The main aim of the seminar was to stress the importance of fair play in sport and to encourage mutual respect, discipline and team spirit. Its specific objectives included:

· raising athletes’ awareness of the impact of ethical behaviour in competition;

· promoting respect for opponents and officials;

· avoiding doping and other unfair practices;

· developing an educational framework on fair play for young athletes.

The seminar included several interactive sessions and presentations by experts in the field.

Topics discussed included:

· the definition and principles of fair play – what fair behaviour in sport means;

· examples of good practice – case studies of athletes who have shown an exemplary spirit of fair play;

· the consequences of a lack of fair play – the negative impact of cheating and misconduct on a sporting career;

· the role of coaches and teachers in promoting ethical values in sport.

Participants welcomed the chance to discuss these issues and stressed the importance of educating athletes in a spirit of respect and fairness. It was also proposed to draw up a good-practice guide to be distributed in sports clubs and schools, to encourage respect for the rules and for the spirit of sport.

In conclusion, the seminar was an important step in promoting a culture based on fair play, with a positive impact on athletes of all ages. The organisers announced that they will continue such initiatives to support the development of clean and fair sport.

Fair play is not just a rule — it is the essence of sport!
